title: Creating DataFrames: Dictionaries of Lists vs Records
description: Demonstrates the two most popular ways to instantiate 2D labeled DataFrames.
code:
import pandas as pd

# 1. Dictionary of lists (column-oriented)
data_cols = {
    "Name": ["Arun", "Priya", "Rahul"],
    "Age": [20, 19, 21],
    "Mark": [85, 92, 78]
}
df1 = pd.DataFrame(data_cols)
print("Column-Oriented DataFrame:\n", df1, sep="")

# 2. List of dictionaries (row-oriented)
data_rows = [
    {"Name": "Arun", "City": "Chennai"},
    {"Name": "Priya", "City": "Bengaluru"}
]
df2 = pd.DataFrame(data_rows)
print("\nRow-Oriented DataFrame:\n", df2, sep="")

title: Accessing Columns, Rows, and Cells (.loc vs .iloc)
description: Select individual columns as Series, multi-columns as DataFrames, and target specific cells.
code:
import pandas as pd

students = pd.DataFrame({
    "Name": ["Arun", "Priya", "Rahul"],
    "Age": [20, 19, 21],
    "Mark": [85, 92, 78]
})

# 1. Column selection
print("Single Column (Series):\n", students["Name"], sep="")
print("\nMulti-Column (DataFrame):\n", students[["Name", "Mark"]], sep="")

# 2. Row access
print("\nFirst Row (.iloc[0]):\n", students.iloc[0].to_string(), sep="")

# 3. Cell coordinate access
print("\nPriya's Mark (.loc[1, 'Mark']):", students.loc[1, "Mark"])
print("Priya's Mark (.iloc[1, 2]):      ", students.iloc[1, 2])

title: Modifying Cells & Adding Calculated Columns
description: Perform in-place mutations and vectorized column arithmetic to expand tables dynamically.
code:
import pandas as pd

students = pd.DataFrame({
    "Name": ["Arun", "Priya", "Rahul"],
    "Mark": [80, 90, 75]
})

# Add calculated bonus column
students["UpdatedMark"] = students["Mark"] + 5

# Modify one cell in-place
students.loc[2, "Mark"] = 78
students["UpdatedMark"] = students["Mark"] + 5

# Add conditional status column
students["Result"] = ["Pass" if m >= 80 else "Review" for m in students["UpdatedMark"]]

print("Expanded DataFrame:\n", students, sep="")

title: Real-World Table: Product Inventory Billing
description: Build a multi-step commercial billing pipeline calculating subtotals, discounts, and final amounts.
code:
import pandas as pd

products = pd.DataFrame({
    "Product": ["Pen", "Bag", "Shoes"],
    "Price": [20, 500, 1500],
    "Quantity": [5, 2, 1]
})

# Calculate subtotal
products["Subtotal"] = products["Price"] * products["Quantity"]

# Apply 10% discount
products["Discount"] = products["Subtotal"] * 0.10

# Calculate final bill
products["Payable"] = products["Subtotal"] - products["Discount"]

print("Commercial Inventory Table:\n", products, sep="")
print("\nGrand Total Payable:", products["Payable"].sum())
